item.title: COMMENTARY: The Politics of Trump’s Continuing Disdain for MLK Day
item.description: Although this was the 40th anniversary of the MLK Day celebrations, Trump waited until the end of the day, Monday, to belatedly issue the standard presidential recognition of the holiday, and unlike presidents before him, he attended no MLK events, nor did he bother with encouraging Americans to celebrate and emulate Dr. King’s examples of working together to accomplish American greatness through peace and love.

item.title: Porter, Good Aren’t the First ICE Shooting Victims
item.description: Trump, ICE and Homeland Security officials had the same stock answer to why there was more gunplay and use of other weaponry in abundance. That was that ICE agents were under attack, and they had the right to defend themselves. Homeland Security officials went further and claimed that attacks were up in 2025 more than 25%.
